title: ETH valuation metric hits level not seen since 2022: Is rally to $2.5K next?
summary: A rare signal from an ETH price indicator suggests Ether is undervalued, while demand in spot and futures markets hints at a rally to $2,500.

title: US lawmakers ask if Trump dangling memecoin event attendance: Report
summary: With a potential scheduling conflict, several senators want to know if the president plans to attend a luncheon for memecoin holders in Florida or just seeking to generate fees.

title: CoreWeave’s $8.5B loan shows how AI is replacing crypto mining finance
summary: CoreWeave’s financing highlights Wall Street’s shift away from volatile, hardware-backed crypto lending toward cash-flow-driven AI infrastructure, according to TheEnergyMag.

title: Pyth Network looks to disrupt data hegemony with new marketplace
summary: With market pricing data currently monopolized by a few players, Pyth seeks to democratize access with a pay-on-demand model beginning with seven big-name providers.

title: Old Bitcoin whales sold $271M in BTC: Is the crypto rally at stake?
summary: Bitcoin whales sold $270 million in BTC on Sunday, but the steady absorption of supply by traders should help bulls maintain their hold on the market momentum.

title: TON blockchain claims sub-second finality with Catchain 2.0 upgrade
summary: Transactions on the Open Network layer-1 blockchain protocol previously took about 10 seconds to settle before the Catchain 2.0 consensus upgrade.

title: Three reasons why Ether traders expect ETH to hold above $1.8K
summary: Onchain and technical data hint that $1,800 may have been the macro price bottom for Ether. Is there sufficient bullish momentum for a rally to $3,000?

title: Binance rolls out prediction markets for app using Predict.fun
summary: The crypto exchange is mounting a challenge to platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket, offering ”gasless” trades as it seeks a share of the $20 billion prediction market.

title: MarketVector and Coinbase launch index tracking Bitcoin and tokenized gold
summary: A new Bitcoin–gold index highlights shifting views on crypto’s role as a store of value as correlations with equities increase and gold outperforms.

title: UK-led Operation Atlantic freezes $12M in crypto scam proceeds
summary: Operation Atlantic, a joint US, UK and Canadian operation, froze more than $12 million tied to crypto approval phishing and identified over 20,000 victims.
